# Drop

> Drop (@ilsrbn/drop) is a Nuxt module that adds small, opt-in browser behaviors to server-rendered or static Nuxt routes (including routes using `noScripts`) without hydrating the page with Vue. One `defineDrop({ state }, ctx => ...)` call per component becomes an independent browser entry mounted on the component root. Core runtime is capped at 5 kB gzip. Requires Nuxt ^4.5.0.

## Docs

- [README: install, quick start, full API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ilsrbn/drop/main/README.md): defineDrop, ctx.root/state/signal/computed/effect/load/onCleanup, state serialization, component contract, build-time errors
- [AGENTS.md: rules and pitfalls for AI coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ilsrbn/drop/main/AGENTS.md): the constraints the compiler enforces, do/don't list
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ilsrbn/drop/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Examples

- [Playground source](https://github.com/ilsrbn/drop/tree/main/playground): a Nuxt app with a session-aware header and login dialog on a `noScripts` route
